settings.hero_body: For the person whose face lights up at these familiar little companions: a complete eight-plush surprise they can keep enjoying long after the birthday is over.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_body: Choose all eight and allow the stated delivery window when planning the birthday.
settings.moods_body: Every pictured design is included, so the birthday surprise is the whole crew.
settings.personality_title: A birthday moment that stays around.
settings.personality_body: Picture their first look, then the shelf or bedside spot the collection will claim. Add your own card and wrapping; celebration props are not part of the set.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: A birthday moment that stays around.
